snippet.title: What is MISFITZ?!
snippet.description:
Sign up for our playtests from our website, and come build the game with the developers! https://www.antiherostudios.com/

In MISFITZ, you control the matchmaking. Team up on the go with other players and keep each other safe until extraction, or leave the team at any moments to betray them if they've pissed you off.

---------------

Antihero Studios is a new kind of indie gaming studio, founded in 2024 by a small team of former Clash Royale Art Director, Brawl Stars game designer, Moco Artist and Candy Crush developers, eager to create something different.

Our mission is to create games worth sharing. To us, that means crafting high-quality games you'll want to play with friends every day, while building Antihero Studios into the gaming brand that resonates with today's players.

---------------
